request.query: An infinite type mapped into a finite type has two distinct elements with the same image

items.name: Set.exists_ne_map_eq_of_ncard_lt_of_maps_to
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {s : Set α} {t : Set β},
  t.ncard < s.ncard →
    ∀ {f : α → β},
      (∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) →
        autoParam t.Finite Set.exists_ne_map_eq_of_ncard_lt_of_maps_to._auto_1 → ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ s, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y

items.name: Set.Infinite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_mapsTo
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {f : α → β},
  s.Infinite → Set.MapsTo f s t → t.Finite → ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ s, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y

items.name: Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] (f : α → β),
  Fintype.card β < Fintype.card α → ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y

items.name: Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite
items.type: ∀ {α : Sort u_4} {β : Sort u_5} [Infinite α] [Finite β] (f : α → β), ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y

items.name: not_injective_infinite_finite
items.type: ∀ {α : Sort u_4} {β : Sort u_5} [Infinite α] [Finite β] (f : α → β), ¬Function.Injective f

items.name: Set.Infinite.exists_lt_map_eq_of_mapsTo
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {f : α → β},
  s.Infinite → Set.MapsTo f s t → t.Finite → ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ s, x < y ∧ f x = f y
